tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background: title bar, tab strip, page ground.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Dock panels (Properties, Project browser, bottom panel). Kept distinct from viewport.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: 3D and plan view background; the working surface.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inputs, search box, type selector, kbd hints.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Count chips in the status bar, neutral pills.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: Selected tree row and active ribbon button background.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels and rows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger dividers: menu, floating-window and resize-frame edges, kbd hints. Decorative; for the boundary of an interactive control use control-border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Boundary of interactive controls: secondary buttons, input fields, selects, the command search. Non-text contrast: at least 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11) against bg, panel, ribbon, viewport, field and chip in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel, ribbon, viewport, field, chip and row-selected.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Property labels, inactive tabs and secondary text on bg, panel, ribbon, viewport, field, chip and row-selected, at least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Group labels, hints, units and read-only values on bg, panel, ribbon, viewport, field, chip and row-selected, at least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange. Active tab underline, selection fills, the primary button. Never used for text, warnings or categories; for focus use focus-ring, for orange text accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text (selected element name, links, active ribbon buttons) on bg, panel, ribbon, viewport, field, chip and row-selected, at least 4.5:1 in both themes. Never set orange text in accent, which is too light for text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline (2 px) and the focused-input border. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes; a darker orange on Paper, where accent is only 2.5:1.

tokens.name: edge-model
tokens.usage: Model edges in 3D. Light on Ink, never black.

tokens.name: hover-outline
tokens.usage: Pre-selection outline on hover. Outline only, no fill.

tokens.name: line-cut
tokens.usage: Cut lines in plan and section (heaviest weight).

tokens.name: line-projection
tokens.usage: Projection lines beyond the cut plane.

tokens.name: cat-wall
tokens.usage: Colour by category: walls and cores.

tokens.name: cat-footing
tokens.usage: Colour by category: footings and rafts.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: QA passed. Always paired with a check icon.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: QA warning. Light yellow so it can never be read as brand orange. Pair with a warning icon.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: QA error. Pair with an error icon; never colour alone.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Revision diff: element removed; draw at opacity-removed.

tokens.name: diff-unchanged
tokens.usage: Revision diff: unchanged; draw at opacity-ghost.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Logo: shaded column face and ring on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: Logo: lit column face on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: Logo: column top face on light grounds.

tokens.name: select-window
tokens.usage: Selection box dragged right (window): takes what is fully inside. Solid outline, AutoCAD convention.

tokens.name: select-crossing
tokens.usage: Selection box dragged left (crossing): takes what it touches. Dashed outline, AutoCAD convention.

tokens.name: reveal-frame
tokens.usage: Reveal Hidden Elements mode: 3 px frame around the view and its label. Magenta, as in Revit.

tokens.name: temp-hide-frame
tokens.usage: Temporary Hide/Isolate mode: 3 px frame around the view and its label. Cyan, as in Revit.

tokens.name: on-temp-hide-frame
tokens.usage: Label text on temp-hide-frame (6.3:1). Dark: white on this cyan is only 2.8:1.

tokens.name: viewcube-top
tokens.usage: ViewCube top face. The cube keeps Revit's light grey in both themes.

tokens.name: viewcube-text
tokens.usage: ViewCube face labels (TOP, FRONT…) on viewcube-top and viewcube-side.

tokens.name: viewcube-ring-edge
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside and outside the compass ring.

tokens.name: viewcube-highlight
tokens.usage: Inner bevel highlight on ViewCube faces.

tokens.name: viewcube-compass
tokens.usage: Compass letters (N, E, S, W) on viewcube-ring.

tokens.name: viewcube-hot
tokens.usage: ViewCube compass hover fill, behind on-viewcube-hot letters. Same in both themes, like the rest of the cube; darker than select-window so white letters reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-viewcube-hot
tokens.usage: Compass letters on viewcube-hot (5.6:1); also the white mixed into the active compass ring.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: properties, tree, ribbon labels. Tabular figures on.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Element IDs, GlobalIds, Python console, logs.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The lowercase wordmark and marketing headlines only. Never inside the app UI.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Base grid unit; gaps inside controls.

shadow.note: Elevation, only for things that float above the app. Docked panels use border hairlines, never shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Hover tooltips in the 3D and DXF views.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers: context menu, Quick Access menu, hide/isolate menu, ViewCube options.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: Marketing screenshots on the homepage only.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: View control bar and status bar height.

tokens.name: bottom-panel
tokens.usage: Default bottom panel height (console, QA, BOQ, activity).

zIndex.note: App-level stacking layers, lowest to highest. Stacking inside one component (sticky table cells, resize handles) stays local with values 1 to 5.

tokens.name: z-view-overlay
tokens.usage: Frames drawn over the viewport: reveal-frame, temp-hide-frame.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus opened from bars: Quick Access menu, hide/isolate menu.

tokens.name: z-window
tokens.usage: FloatingWindow base; each window raised above the last (FloatingWindow.tsx counts up from here).

tokens.name: z-context-menu
tokens.usage: Right-click menus, above everything including floating windows.
